title: Distributed Martian Atmospheric CO₂ Processing Swarms: A Conceptual Architecture for Plasma-Vortex ISRU and Autonomous Microreactors
description: A speculative concept study exploring distributed swarms of autonomous ultralight atmospheric microdevices for Martian CO₂ processing using compact plasma-vortex reactors. The manuscript distinguishes demonstrated evidence, literature-supported mechanisms, engineering extrapolation, and long-horizon speculation.
